title: Random Utility Models in the Consumption-Budget Setting: Vertex and Network-Flow Characterizations
abstract: arXiv:2611.17692v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This note supplements our paper \textit{Alternative Computational Formulations for Testing Discrete-Choice Random Utility Models: Half-Space and Network-Flow Formulations} and serves two purposes:   1. We clarify the conceptual distinctions between two classes of random utility models (RUM): those in the consumption-budget setting \citep{kitamura2019nonparametric} (hereafter KS) and those in the finite-alternative setting (e.g., Chapter~7 of \cite{chambers2016revealed}). In particular, we show (Theorem 1) that each rational type, as defined in KS, can be obtained as a coordinate projection of the deterministic choice vector induced by a strict preference ranking that satisfies what we call a patch-monotonicity condition.   2. translated_title: 消费-预算设定下的随机效用模型：顶点与网络流刻画
translated_abstract: 本短文是我们论文《检验离散选择随机效用模型的替代计算表述：半空间与网络流表述》的补充，包含两个目的：1. 我们澄清了两类随机效用模型（RUM）之间的概念区别：消费-预算设定下的模型（即KS模型）与有限备选方案设定下的模型。特别地，我们证明（定理1）KS中所定义的每个理性类型，都可以通过一个满足我们称之为“块单调性”条件的严格偏好排序所诱导的确定性选择向量的坐标投影来获得。2. 我们将Fiorini (2004)中针对有限备选方案随机效用模型的网络流刻画推广到消费-预算设定（定理2）。具体而言，我们证明了一个选择概率向量……
tldr: 本文澄清了消费-预算设定与有限备选方案设定下两类随机效用模型的概念区别，证明KS理性类型可由满足块单调性条件的严格偏好排序所诱导的确定性选择向量的坐标投影获得，并将有限备选情形下的网络流刻画推广到消费-预算设定。
en_tdlr: This note clarifies the conceptual distinction between consumption-budget and finite-alternative random utility models—showing that KS rational types arise as coordinate projections of deterministic choice vectors induced by strict preference rankings satisfying a patch-monotonicity condition—and generalizes the network-flow characterization of finite-alternative RUMs to the consumption-budget setting.
